text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Twelve Tunisian immigrants expelled by France. President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali asks Foreign Affairs Minister Habib Ben Yahia to follow up the problem.
- National Solidarity Fund spent 194 million dinars for the poor during the past three years.
- The ruling Constitutional Democratic Rally (RCD) party names new representatives in several provinces.
